mode: live API source review; advisory only, no production validation

late_success.instructions: Does the supplied print lifecycle allow a result arriving after cancellation or deadline expiry to be returned as successful and then saved by the supplied CreativeCanvas handler?

uncancellable_save_claim.instructions: Can the supplied visible Cancel print preparation button report that no file was saved after durable StorageService.saveItem persistence has already started?

stuck_cleanup.instructions: Does BrowserUpscale still await the enhancement engine ready/dispose promise without a deadline in its finally cleanup, keeping the UI busy after a stage deadline rejects?

progress_regression.instructions: Do browser stage label updates reset enhancement progress to its initial value after tiles have completed, rather than retaining the fraction of completed tiles?
